note: One row per trial. Paper edits this file when a trial starts, is judged, wins, or is killed. 'live' keys are filled in by scripts/scoreboard.py at render time.

experiments.name: Momentum crypto v2 (BTC 50% core + top-2 alts) vs old top-4
experiments.hypothesis: A 50% BTC core plus the top 2 momentum alts beats the old equal top-4 momentum book.
experiments.rule: Revert if v2 trails the old book by more than 2 pts.
experiments.result_text: DECIDED 11/09: KEEP v2. Since 10/12 v2 -11.38% (NAV $21,793.16) vs old top-4 -15.18% (NAV $20,858.31). Gap +3.8 pts; rule was revert only if v2 trailed by >2 pts.

experiments.name: Relative-strength alt filter
experiments.hypothesis: An alt keeps its 15% slot only if its 63d return beats BTC's; otherwise the slot goes to BTC.
experiments.rule: Promote if it leads v2 by more than 1.5 pts with no more than 2 pts extra drawdown; kill if it trails by more than 1 pt or never diverges.
experiments.result_text: 11/09: first divergence. Top-2 AVAX/ETH; only AVAX beats BTC 63d (AVAX +6.9%, ETH -14.8%, BTC -5.6%). Shadow sold SOL and added BTC. Shadow -5.88% vs live v2 -5.86% since 10/26 (gap -0.02 pts). Decide 11/23.

experiments.name: Mean-reversion equity satellite (up to 10%)
experiments.hypothesis: A weekly bottom-8 mean-reversion satellite adds return without adding drawdown.
experiments.control: Momentum book inside the same sleeve
experiments.result_text: Funded 11/02. Weekly rebalance 11/09: sold XLC 12 and AMZN 5; bought QQQ 1 and NVDA 7. Holds GLD, EEM, IWM, XLI, AVGO, GOOGL, QQQ, NVDA (~8.7% of equity NAV). Backtest 11/09: weekly mean-rev +19.66% 1y (DD -7.05%) vs monthly mom -0.16%. Decide 12/07.
experiments.rule: Keep if satellite return since 11/02 beats the momentum book with no more than 1 pt extra sleeve drawdown; kill if it trails momentum by more than 2 pts.

experiments.name: Weekly shadow book vs monthly live equity
experiments.hypothesis: Monthly rebalancing does as well as weekly with less turnover.
experiments.control: Weekly 63d momentum + top-10 buffer, simulated, never booked
experiments.rule: Revert to weekly if live trails the shadow by more than 1.5 pts or adds more than 1 pt drawdown over the 4 monthly rebalances 11/02 to 02/01. First judge 11/02.
experiments.result_text: 11/09 mark (not a monthly judge): live monthly -1.84% vs weekly shadow -1.64% since 10/19 (gap -0.20 pts). Shadow traded XLK→XLP. Inside thresholds; next formal judge 12/07.

experiments.name: Active equity rotation funding (rule v9)
experiments.hypothesis: Selling the weakest trend to fund a stronger one fixes cash starvation and helps Active beat the baseline.
experiments.rule: Kill if rotations lose money on net over 4 weeks and Active falls behind the 50/50 baseline.

experiments.name: Kronos-small regime filter for crypto alts
experiments.hypothesis: Holding BTC instead of alts when Kronos paths are scattered (choppy) beats live v2.
experiments.result_text: 11/09: regime BTC trending down, LINK trending down, ETH/SOL/AVAX choppy. No alt qualifies; shadow 80% BTC. Shadow -3.17% vs live v2 -2.99% since 11/02 (gap -0.18 pts). Cron was silent 11/03-11/08 (only 11/02 log); manually refreshed today. Decide 12/07.
experiments.rule: Promote if it leads v2 by more than 1.5 pts with no more than 2 pts extra drawdown; kill if it trails by more than 1 pt or the regime label never changes.

experiments.name: Equal-weight universe at 80% invested (monthly)
experiments.hypothesis: Equal-weighting the equity universe at 80% invested beats live monthly momentum with less selection risk.
experiments.control: Live monthly momentum book (70%) + MR satellite (10%)
experiments.rule: Promote to a live satellite or core replacement study if it leads the live equity sleeve by >2 pts with no more than 1.5 pts extra drawdown; kill if it trails by >2 pts.
experiments.result_text: Started 11/09 from method_backtest: 1y equal_weight_universe_80pct_monthly +9.70% (DD -6.64%) vs monthly_mom_top8 -0.16% (DD -9.52%). Simulated only; not booked.
